Following convention, users who post on X with the #AppleEvent hashtag in the coming days will receive a custom Apple logo hashmoji attached to their posts. See below for details.

#AppleEvent hashmoji is now live on X

For years, every time Apple schedules a new event, the company launches a custom X hashmoji to match the event.

Following the event invitation sent earlier today — featuring an apple-shaped halo surrounding the sun, paired with the tagline "Surprise and shine" — the company's new hashmoji is now live on X.

That means users posting with #AppleEvent on the platform will see a custom Apple logo designed after the invitation graphic appear next to the hashtag.

Apple's "Surprise and shine" event is scheduled for September 9 at 10 a.m. Pacific Time, with the company expected to announce the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, as well as its first foldable iPhone. There are also rumors of new Apple Watch and AirPods models.

Apple's hashmoji went live on X just hours after Greg Jozwiak, the company's Senior Vice President of Marketing, hinted at it with a post on X. Tim Cook subsequently reposted Jozwiak's post and added his own message.

Interestingly, some have interpreted Cook's mention of a countdown as an Easter egg, hinting at his own countdown: he has just days left before stepping down as Apple CEO on September 1 to become Executive Chairman of the company.

9to5Mac will be on the ground at Apple Park on September 9, so be sure to follow our coverage before, during, and after the event.

What are you looking forward to from this event? Let us know in the comments.
